item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 29/Apr/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A trough of low pressure will bring showers to southern China today. Under the influence of the relatively dry northeast monsoon, it will be bright in the following couple of days. An anticyclone aloft will affect Guangdong midweek next week. The weather will improve and it will be hot during the day apart from one or two showers over the region. Another trough of low pressure will affect the coastal areas in the latter part of next week.
